## About
AE German Car Service is an independently owned shop in Santa Monica. We offer full-service car repair and preventive maintenance, and we specialize in German and other European vehicles.
Our goal is to get the service or repair on your car right the first time. When we find something, we explain it plainly, show you the parts, and let you decide what's worth doing now.
Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating across 117 Google reviews, and many of them mention the same things: honest advice, fair prices and work done with care.

## Services
- Oil change: Engine and transmission oil changes for your German or European car.
- Full vehicle inspection: A careful look over your car that can catch problems before they turn into bigger ones.
- Diagnostics: We track down the problem, explain it clearly and give you a detailed estimate before work begins.
- Air condition repair: Air condition repair for German and European cars.
- Air suspension repair: Repair work on air suspension systems.
- Water pump repair: Water pump work as part of keeping your cooling system healthy.
- Power steering repair: Fixing power steering problems so your car handles the way it should.
- Scope engine tune up: Engine tune up work to keep your engine running smoothly.

## FAQ
Q: Which cars do you work on?
A: We work on Mini Cooper, Mercedes, BMW, Audi, Porsche, Volkswagen and Land Rover, along with other European vehicles.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Do you explain optional work before doing it?
A: Yes. We walk you through the pros and cons of optional work so you can decide what makes sense for you.
